confirmed: The $4 support-ticket cost calculation reproduces at $0.128
The ticket's cost-per-quirq, margin, multiple and divisible-settlement calculations reproduce after normal rounding
Table 1's monthly total costs and monthly QER values reproduce
The +141% quirq-velocity and +83% inference-spend figures reproduce
State-based verification is stronger than agent self-report
The paper clearly discloses that E1-E3 are mock-mode machinery demonstrations and that real-agent, predictive-validity and budget-governance claims remain open
issues: Table 1's exact QER increase is 77.1%, not 81%; 81% is obtained improperly from rounded display values
Table 1 does not expose enough inputs to reproduce potential value, minted Q or intervention rate
The audit correction has the wrong sign: maximally farmed checks can increase rather than reduce corrected QER
The audit correction is also invalid as an unweighted portfolio multiplier when unit budgets differ
QER is a budgeted benefit-cost ratio, not ROI
IR measures failed or unsettled units, not actual human interventions
Quirqs measure assigned budget times check completion, not causally realized business impact
The all-in cost claim omits specification, budgeting, auditing, acceptance, governance and downstream-error costs
Non-decreasing memory does not logically imply non-increasing cost
Budget setters and owners can game budgets, unit selection, acceptance and decomposition
The formalism lacks budget conservation, duplicate-credit prevention, clawbacks and negative settlement
Several load-bearing claims are absent from or mistiered in the claim ledger
Reference 4 misstates the title and authorship of arXiv:2511.18397
Reference 15 could not be verified as the joint MIT and AI Consulting Network report cited
Cross-company comparability is not established, and quirqs per kWh is not dimensionless
receipt.one_line: The ledger is a useful accounting scaffold, but it does not yet measure business impact, its audit correction is mathematically backward, and its anti-gaming claims remain unproven.
